evidence.note: Discovery issuer has a trailing slash; the configured issuer does not. Issuer comparison is an exact string match, so validation fails (IDX10205).

output.fix: Make the configured issuer (ValidIssuer or Authority) exactly equal to the issuer value in the discovery document, including the trailing slash: https://login.example.com/tenant-1/v2.0/. Alternatively, load the issuer from the discovery metadata instead of hard-coding it. Also remove any old sts.windows.net issuer, because v2.0 tokens use the new issuer. Keep signature, audience and lifetime validation on. Don't turn off issuer validation or match issuers loosely. If the tokens' iss claim has no trailing slash, then the OP's discovery document and its tokens disagree. Raise that with the OP rather than loosening validation.
questions: What is the iss claim in the actual ID token? Does it have a trailing slash?
